result.topic_en: Calculations toward Riemann's Paris prize essay on heat conduction: on the left, integration of a partial differential equation in variables alpha and beta with logarithmic substitutions; on the right, quadratic-form and Christoffel-symbol-type identities for coefficients a_{i,i'} in coordinates s_1, s_2, s_3.

methods.what: Reduction of a second-order PDE by a first integral and the substitution p = d log m / d beta
Christoffel-symbol-type identity expressing second derivatives of Cartesian coordinates via derivatives of metric coefficients
methods.quote: $2\sum\frac{\partial^2 x}{\partial s_i\partial s_{i'}}\frac{\partial x}{\partial s_{i''}} = \frac{\partial a_{i,i''}}{\partial s_{i'}} + \frac{\partial a_{i',i''}}{\partial s_i} - \frac{\partial a_{i,i'}}{\partial s_{i''}}$

methods.what: Completing the square of a ternary quadratic differential form (line element)
methods.quote: $(ds_1 + a\,ds_2 + b\,ds_3)^2 + \frac{1}{c}(ds_2 c + e\,ds_3 + \ldots ds_3)(c\,ds_2 + e\,ds_3 - \ldots ds_3)$

methods.what: Inverse metric components as cofactors divided by the determinant
methods.quote: $\left(\frac{\partial s_3}{\partial x}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial s_3}{\partial y}\right)^2 + \left(\frac{\partial s_3}{\partial z}\right)^2 = \frac{a_{1,1}a_{2,2} - a_{1,2}^2}{\Delta}$

methods.what: Computation of the Laplacian of a coordinate function in terms of the metric coefficients
methods.quote: $2\left(\frac{\partial^2 s_1}{\partial x^2} + \ldots\right) = \frac{\partial\frac{a_{2,2}a_{3,3} - a_{2,3}^2}{\Delta}}{\partial s_1} + \frac{\partial\frac{1}{\Delta}}{\partial s_2}(a_{3,1}a_{2,3} - a_{2,1}a_{3,3}) + \frac{\partial\frac{1}{\Delta}}{\partial s_3}(a_{2,1}a_{3,2} - a_{1,1}a_{2,3})$
